title: The Holiday of the Released Fingerprints
description: On the potters’ late-summer holiday, the marks left on unfired bowls rise into the air. An apprentice watches the last gold whorl lift from the rim.
alt: A potter steadies a terracotta bowl on a wheel as glowing fingerprint whorls rise above it. An apprentice watches from the right.
pairing: A potters’ late-summer holiday × fingerprints that lift from unfired clay
